title: Educational content section (how to build a fast car)
description: Spun off during 0003 (web front-end) planning, 2026-06-02. A learning/reference section of the site alongside the simulator: how to build an awesome pinewood derby car - the physics behind the best design decisions and what you should actually do, in priority order (weight & placement, friction/axle prep & lubrication, alignment/rail-riding, wheels, then aerodynamics). Reinforces the profile's learning goal and 'rich physics, simple presentation' constraint: plain-language, visual, age-appropriate (~7-12), no Joules/Newtons/coefficients. Ideally cross-links to the simulator so a kid can read a principle then try it. Static content - no backend needed. OPEN QUESTIONS for its planning: reconcile target age range (profile ~7-12 vs spec 12-17); how tightly to couple/deep-link with the simulator and the 0002 explanation wording; content source/accuracy review. Status: placeholder; user will iterate on it in a later session.
